architectural_observation_successor_act_.headline: Active-run blocks commit via BCB barrier's lastDecision consult, NOT via completionCommitHoldReasons
architectural_observation_successor_act_.details: The LIVE contract (active run blocks commit until agent_turn_done) is currently enforced by the BCB barrier's checkElmCompletionAuthority consult of lastDecision, which reflects computeHoldReasons (unfiltered). The Elm kernel has a more permissive rule (completionCommitHoldReasons in Authority.elm:453-460 that filters ActiveRun when commitReadyRun == activeRun), but it is consulted ONLY inside handleTaskCompletionCommitted — and task_completion_committed is excluded from AUTHORITY_STAGES. Therefore completionCommitHoldReasons is dead code at the BCB barrier site. The H1_ELM_TOO_STRICT verdict from ACT-CLINEMM-COMPLETION-AUTHORITY-ELM-COMMIT-WHILE-RUN-ACTIVE-DISCRIMINATOR01 identified this gap; addressing it requires a separate, larger ACT and is OUT OF SCOPE for this ACT.
